تصطفون (form VIII)
# تَصْطَفُونَ (taṣṭafūna) /tasˤ.tˤa.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# تُصْطَفَوْنَ (tuṣṭafawna) /tusˤ.tˤa.faw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
